6562.title: Selected Claude skill expansion depends on prompt position
6562.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude bridge leaves selected skills embedded in prompt text, where the native parser does not expand the user-only skill body.
6562.proposedFix: Place one validated selected skill at the start of the combined SDK prompt while preserving surrounding input.
6562.caveats: Verified for embedded mentions on trusted main, not the reporter's macOS release. Leading commands work. A local candidate passes the focused regression, but no PR is safe under the required green-suite gate because six baseline provider-suite failures remain. Scripts and test patch are inline per the reports repository policy.
